selects Card: W 343, H 645, layout panel shown
selects the tags 'Board' (sporty / weekend / pink) and deletes it (gone at 00:11.0)
clicks a sizing option in the Card's flex board section
drags the Card's right edge to make it wider (W 385 at 00:35.5), then inspects HeaderWrapper and the Text layers (00:35.5-00:48)
resizes the Card again, down to about W 248 (00:58.5)

actual: After the tags Board is deleted (00:11.0), the Card keeps H 645 and an empty gap stays between the 'Text:' block and the divider (00:11.0-00:22.0); only after the user clicks the sizing option again (00:24) does the Card shrink to H 597 and the gap close (00:28.5). After widening the Card (00:35.5) the text reflows to fewer lines but the HeaderWrapper and the 'Text' layer keep their old heights (HeaderWrapper H 93.78 at 00:43, Text H 57 at 00:45), leaving empty space under the text (00:40-00:45). After narrowing the Card to about W 248 (00:58.5-01:00) the text wraps to more lines but the containers do not grow: 'sed do eiusmod' overlaps the 'Text:' block and the price '00€' touches the stars.
